nodes.name: Manual Trigger
nodes.notes: Manually trigger AI scoring for papers

parameters.query: SELECT id, doi, title, abstract, published_date, category FROM public.research_papers WHERE relevance_score IS NULL OR ai_summary IS NULL OR category IS NULL ORDER BY published_date DESC LIMIT 50;

nodes.name: Fetch Unscored Papers
nodes.notes: Get papers that haven not been scored yet

parameters.jsCode:
const i=$input.all();const prep=[];for(const x of i){if(x.json.id&&x.json.title){prep.push({json:{id:x.json.id,doi:x.json.doi,title:x.json.title,abstract:x.json.abstract||'No abstract',published_date:x.json.published_date,input_text:'Title: '+x.json.title+'

Abstract: '+(x.json.abstract||'No abstract')}});}}return prep.length>0?prep:[{json:{no_papers:true}}];

parameters.text: Analyze the research paper and provide: 1. Relevance Score (0-100) based on novelty and quality 2. Summary (one sentence, max 50 words) 3. Category (ML, NLP, CV, Robotics, Data Mining, Software Engineering, Systems, Security, Theory, HCI, Other). Paper: {{ $json.input_text }}. Respond ONLY with JSON: {"score": <number>, "summary": "<text>", "category": "<category>"}

nodes.name: LLM Scoring
nodes.notes: AI analyzes paper and returns score, summary, category

parameters.jsCode: const items=$input.all();const res=[];for(const i of items){try{const o=i.json.text||i.json.output||'';let p={score:0,summary:'',category:'Other'};const m=o.match(/\{[\s\S]*?\}/);if(m)try{p=JSON.parse(m[0])}catch(e){const s=o.match(/"score"\s*:\s*(\d+)/i);const sm=o.match(/"summary"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"/i);const cm=o.match(/"category"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"/i);if(s)p.score=parseInt(s[1]);if(sm)p.summary=sm[1];if(cm)p.category=cm[1];}if(p.score<0)p.score=0;if(p.score>100)p.score=100;res.push({json:{id:i.json.id,doi:i.json.doi,relevance_score:p.score,ai_summary:p.summary||'',category:p.category||'Other'}});}catch(e){res.push({json:{error:e.message}});}}return res;
